# CeremonyVerse

> CeremonyVerse is a U.S.-based service with two distinct offers: Indian wedding shopping for families throughout the United States and Canada, and destination-wedding planning support for Gujarati and Hindu families across Mexico and Punta Cana.

## About

CeremonyVerse organizes remote India shopping and destination-wedding planning support. India-shopping differentiators include eligible live video review, documented approvals, measurement coordination, pre-shipping review, and U.S. or Canada shipping-document and tracking support. Destination services can include planning, on-site execution, family support, guest information, welcome-item coordination, and India sourcing as defined in a written proposal.

- [About CeremonyVerse](https://www.ceremonyverse.com/about/): Family experience, current service coverage, and planning approach
- [How It Works](https://www.ceremonyverse.com/how-it-works/): Step-by-step process from consultation to delivery
- [Services Overview](https://www.ceremonyverse.com/services/): India shopping and destination-wedding planning support
- [Pricing](https://www.ceremonyverse.com/pricing/): India tiers ($249, $799, $2,499) and destination-planning packages starting at $4,000, $5,500, and $8,000
- [FAQ](https://www.ceremonyverse.com/faq/): 15+ questions on trust, sizing, pricing, shipping, and cultural traditions

## Family Experience & Service Boundaries

- CeremonyVerse describes family-side involvement in Indian destination weddings in Mexico as background, not as CeremonyVerse client work. The About page explains the current service model, and the Family Wedding Experience page contains the anonymous public examples.
- India-shopping service fees are in USD and flat by tier for U.S. and Canadian clients; products, shipping, insurance, duties, Canadian taxes, brokerage, and local alteration costs are separate unless a signed agreement says otherwise.
- Destination-planning packages start at $8,000 for Full Planning & Design, $5,500 for Partial Planning & Coordination, and $4,000 for Event Coordination & Management. The final written proposal identifies the selected scope and applicable additions.
- The proposal identifies the bundled CeremonyVerse service, outside costs, payment milestones, and responsibility for each decision.
- Timing, fit, color, customs clearance, and duty amounts are not universally guaranteed.
- Fit Assurance applies only to eligible made-to-measure garments when included in signed service terms.
- Strongest stated India sourcing relationships are in Surat and Delhi; other locations depend on responsible vendor verification.

## Trust & Verification

- Researched vendor options, documented approvals, and limitations explained before purchase
- Live video review when the vendor, item, and selected service allow it, with limitations documented before approval
- Payment milestones are defined in each signed proposal or service agreement
- Available pre-shipping review when included in the selected service scope
- U.S. or Canada shipping, tracking method, customs responsibilities, and available insurance are itemized for the approved shipment
- Fit Assurance on eligible made-to-measure garments
- Clear written proposals with the client price and applicable outside costs identified before approval
